why: Lines where the apiserver failed calling an admission webhook. If the webhook pod is dead or timing out, create and update requests are rejected (Jetstack)
query: fields @timestamp, @message | filter @logStream like /kube-apiserver-/ and (@message like /failed calling webhook/ or @message like /webhook.*context deadline exceeded/) | parse @message /webhook "(?<webhook>[^"]+)"/ | stats count() as c by webhook | sort c desc | limit 20
